title: Name each transaction in a merchant's daily report

blocks.text: Merchants compare the acquirer's end-of-day report with their tills, and a coffee chain has opened a ticket: on some days the report shows more sales than its tills, on others fewer. The acquirer reaches Visa over both kinds of link, and its terminals send every kind of account their cards offer.

`DailyReport` in `src/main/java/com/example/practice/DailyReport.java` already walks the messages the acquirer sent and adds up the amounts per kind. Finish the three methods marked `TODO` that decide what each message is:

items: `undoesAnother`: whether a message cancels an earlier one;
`asksAboutMoney`: whether a message is about a transaction with the cardholder's money at all;
`byProcessingCode`: purchase, cash or refund, from field 3.

cases.says: financial messages for a purchase, a cash withdrawal and a refund get those names
a day of purchases and a refund adds up per kind, and a network message adds nothing
a network management message is no transaction
only the first two digits of field 3 name the type; the account digits change nothing
a message of the reversal class is a reversal, whatever its field 3 repeats
authorization-class messages name their transaction by field 3 just as financial ones do
a reversal request and a repeated reversal advice are reversals as much as a first advice is

origin.section: 5.3. The MTI and the Processing Code Together Name the Transaction

concepts: The class digit says authorization, financial or reversal, the first two digits of field 3 say purchase, cash or refund, and the account digits change neither.
